description: ES256 on two P-256 keys without kid fails with MultipleMatchingKeys; decided by ADR 0054 §4: both P-256 members pass every check (§2.1; neither has alg, use, key_ops or kid), so two match, and set order implies no preference (RFC 7517 §5.1); outcome hand-derived from the ADR 0054 text (conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/specs/select.json), never computed by polyjose
